title: fitXI
one_liner: An offline-first player load and wellness monitoring PWA for football clubs in Zimbabwe and southern Africa.
problem: Many clubs lack affordable tools to consistently track training load and player wellness.
approach: Combines session RPE and daily wellness check-ins with offline logging, background sync, dashboards, and transparent traffic-light indicators.
highlights: Designed for offline use on affordable Android devices
Tracks session RPE, training load, sleep, soreness, and mood
Uses transparent rule-based load and wellness indicators
Supports background synchronization after connectivity returns
Includes CSV export for clubs and federations
Designed with consent, club isolation, and minimal data collection

title: MbongeRedeem Portfolio
one_liner: A clean, minimalist portfolio template for Backend Engineers, built with Next.js 14 and Tailwind CSS.
problem: Backend engineers need a professional portfolio to showcase technical maturity, system architecture, and infrastructure skills.
approach: Provides a ready-to-use, dark-mode-first Next.js 14 app with Tailwind CSS, Lucide React icons, and JetBrains Mono typography, allowing easy content customization.
highlights: Dark mode first Tailwind CSS styling
Deployable via Vercel with minimal setup
